name: Taming the Beast
summary: Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar can teach you to tame a beast. Your time in the highlands has prepared you to seek an animal companion.

sections.title: A New Companion
sections.body: You have grown more comfortable in the highlands, and your host believes you are ready to seek an animal companion. Go to Valanaar and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale; he will begin teaching you the art of beast taming.

faq.answer: Quel'ana Quickgale teaches you the art of beast taming in Valanaar.

faq.q: Where do I find Quel'ana Quickgale?
faq.answer: Quel'ana Quickgale is in Valanaar, the port to the southeast.

faq.q: Why am I going to Valanaar?
faq.answer: You are sent to Valanaar to speak with Quel'ana Quickgale and begin learning beast taming.
Quel'ana Quickgale will teach you how to tame a beast so you can seek an animal companion.

attribution: In-game quest text: Taming the Beast
